intro: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette at CAVA brings bold North African flavor to your bowl or pita with its signature blend of harissa pepper paste and tangy vinegar. At just 70 calories, this spicy-smoky dressing adds authentic Mediterranean heat to any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Perfect for those who crave adventurous flavors without compromising nutrition.
priceCalories: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette is included with your order at no extra charge (up to 2 dressings) and contains only 70 calories per serving. With 7g of fat, 1g of carbs, and 0g of protein, this dressing delivers maximum flavor impact with minimal caloric investment. Compare it to other options on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) to find your perfect match.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Hot Harissa Vinaigrette apart is its authentic harissa pepper paste base, delivering smoky, spicy complexity that transforms ordinary bowls into extraordinary meals. Unlike typical hot sauces, this vinaigrette balances heat with tangy acidity, creating layers of flavor. It is one of the most calorie-conscious options on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) while providing bold taste.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Hot Harissa Vinaigrette contains 70 calories, with 7g of fat as the primary macronutrient. With just 1g of carbohydrates and 0g of protein, this dressing fits seamlessly into low-carb and keto-friendly meal plans. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track how this dressing fits into your complete meal nutritional profile.
whatsInside: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette features harissa pepper paste as its star ingredient, blended into a classic vinaigrette base. Harissa traditionally combines roasted red peppers, hot chilies, garlic, and warming spices like cumin and coriander. The vinaigrette component adds acidity and helps distribute the bold flavors evenly across your [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) selections.
tasteLike: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette delivers a smoky, spicy kick with tangy vinegar brightness that awakens your palate. The initial taste brings forward roasted pepper sweetness, followed by building heat and aromatic spice notes. The vinegar component cuts through rich ingredients, while the harissa provides lingering warmth. It balances heat with complexity rather than overwhelming your taste buds.
customize: Customize your Hot Harissa Vinaigrette experience by pairing it with a second dressing from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) like Lemon Herb Tahini for creamy heat balance. Choose cooling bases like Saffron Basmati Rice or greens to offset the spice. Add mild proteins and creamy spreads from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) to create your perfect flavor profile.
pairsWell: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette pairs exceptionally well with grilled chicken, spicy lamb meatballs, or falafel from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). It complements cooling ingredients like cucumber, tomatoes, and tzatziki while enhancing roasted vegetables. Try it on [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) items or create your own combination for a personalized Mediterranean experience.
healthyChoice: At 70 calories with minimal carbs, Hot Harissa Vinaigrette is an excellent choice for health-conscious diners seeking bold flavor without excess calories. The vinegar base supports digestion, while harissa peppers contain capsaicin, which may boost metabolism. This dressing allows you to enjoy satisfying heat while maintaining nutritional goals, making it ideal for balanced Mediterranean eating from the [full CAVA menu](/).
howToOrder: Order Hot Harissa Vinaigrette by selecting it as one of your two included dressings when building your bowl or pita at CAVA. Simply specify it when customizing your meal at the dressing station. You can request it on the side for controlled application or drizzled directly over your creation. Visit [CAVA Locations](/locations) to enjoy this flavorful dressing today.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Garlic Dressing at 180 calories, Hot Harissa Vinaigrette offers 110 fewer calories while delivering more complexity. Greek Vinaigrette provides 130 calories with milder flavor, while Skhug at 80 calories delivers herbaceous heat. Lemon Herb Tahini matches the 70-calorie count but offers creamy texture instead of vinegar brightness. Hot Harissa balances heat intensity with sophisticated spice notes.
whoShouldTry: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette is perfect for spice lovers seeking authentic Mediterranean heat and anyone following low-calorie or low-carb diets. Adventurous eaters wanting to explore North African flavors will appreciate its complexity. Those who enjoy foods from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) with bold seasonings should definitely try this signature dressing for an elevated taste experience.
worthTrying: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette is absolutely worth trying for its authentic flavor, impressive nutritional profile, and versatile pairing potential. At no additional cost and only 70 calories, it transforms any CAVA meal into a memorable culinary experience. Whether you are a regular or first-timer exploring the [full CAVA menu](/), this dressing showcases Mediterranean cuisine at its boldest and most delicious.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Hot Harissa Vinaigrette?
faqs.a: CAVA Hot Harissa Vinaigrette contains 70 calories per serving, with 7g of fat, 1g of carbs, and 0g of protein. It is one of the lighter dressing options available on the menu, included at no extra charge up to two dressings per order.

faqs.q: Is Hot Harissa Vinaigrette very spicy?
faqs.a: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette delivers moderate to bold heat depending on individual spice tolerance. The harissa pepper paste provides smoky warmth with building spiciness, balanced by tangy vinegar. It is spicier than Greek Vinaigrette but offers complex flavor beyond simple heat.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Hot Harissa Vinaigrette?
faqs.a: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette is made with harissa pepper paste blended into a vinaigrette base. Harissa traditionally includes roasted red peppers, hot chilies, garlic, and spices like cumin and coriander, combined with oil and vinegar for the signature tangy-spicy profile.

faqs.q: Is Hot Harissa Vinaigrette gluten-free and vegan?
faqs.a: Hot Harissa Vinaigrette is typically vegan-friendly as it contains harissa pepper paste and vinaigrette ingredients. For specific allergen and gluten-free information, check the CAVA Allergen Menu or consult with staff at your location to confirm current ingredient formulations and preparation methods.

faqs.q: Can I get Hot Harissa Vinaigrette on the side?
faqs.a: Yes, you can request Hot Harissa Vinaigrette on the side when ordering your CAVA bowl or pita. This allows you to control the amount of dressing and heat level according to your preference. Up to two dressings are included with each order at no additional cost.
